evidence.text: The scan’s 學 entry proposes that the two construction patterns described in the preceding text began to combine in Shang forms. It then proposes that Western Zhou forms added 子 to mark the child as the object of learning. These are the entry’s attributed explanations, not independently established chronology or consensus. The entry concludes with the credit “（张標）,” which bounds this material as the 學 entry; the next headword begins separately in the right column.
